card.name: Guapacha
card.tagline: Cuban rhythm/style related to the cha-cha-cha.
card.profile: Guapacha (also 'wa-pa-cha') is a Cuban rhythm and social-dance style, a trendy variant of the guaracha/cha-cha-cha that peaked in the early 1960s. The Cuba Music Week genre database describes it as a trendy Cuban social dance based on the guaracha; on a Tito Rodriguez LP it was promoted as 'nothing more than the Cha Cha with clapping accompaniment.' In ballroom technique, 'guapacha timing' denotes a characteristic syncopation (delaying a step) applied within cha-cha-cha figures (Cuba Music Week; Wikibooks).
card.insight: Guapacha survives less as an independent genre than as 'guapacha timing,' a syncopated rhythmic device used by cha-cha-cha dancers; it is also associated with the singer Amado Borcela, nicknamed 'Guapacha' (Wikibooks).
